rubric_mode_reason: The project requires an executable mechanism that predicts a linked market-state transition beyond fitting equity returns.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: The project uses a custom four-input, three-output chronological gate harness; the scalar global curve-fit adapter cannot evaluate its linked-state ABI.
persona: You are an adversarial asset-pricing researcher. Search for a compact executable action or transition mechanism over the frozen implied-ERP and term-spread state. Every Python candidate must preserve the module ABI fit_model(visible_rows) -> parameter mapping, I_model(features, params=None) -> float, and predict_state_change(features, params=None) -> (erp_innovation, term_spread_change); a return-only or uncalibrated equation is invalid. Autoresearch proposes the form while the deterministic harness fits parameters only on the visible partition. Each linked coordinate must beat its strongest identical-information control. Both cross-coordinate finite-difference sensitivities must be nonzero and retain their signs across the chronological partitions. Preserve the LAGRANGIAN declaration and its variable metadata when the mechanism is action-derived. Compare every proposal against controls using identical information. Reject physics vocabulary that does not produce a distinct, testable prediction.

dimensions.name: Chronological primary forecast
dimensions.description: Does the candidate beat zero, historical mean, and same-information level/change/interaction controls on next-year total-return loss across both frozen chronological partitions?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does the candidate predict next-year return-orthogonal ERP innovation and term-spread change beyond zero-change and same-state controls? Return fit without per-coordinate linked-state gain earns no Newton credit.

dimensions.name: Mechanism and rivals
dimensions.description: Is the action or transition mechanism explicit and executable through both required module functions, with current, drift, interaction, transition, and shrinkage rivals using the same inputs?

dimensions.name: Economic consequence
dimensions.description: Does a bounded paper policy improve after-cost outcome without deriving authority from the backtest?

dimensions.name: Parsimony and stability
dimensions.description: Is the model compact and stable across partitions and reasonable coordinate perturbations?

penalties: NO_LINKED_STATE: A return-only candidate scores zero on Generative linked state.
WEAK_RIVAL: A candidate that omits the same-information interaction or shrinkage control cannot pass.
TEMPORAL_OVERCLAIM: Current-snapshot historical evidence cannot grant prospective or capital authority.
PHYSICS_LABEL_ONLY: Lagrangian or probability-current language without a distinct executable discriminator scores zero on Mechanism and rivals.

criteria.Chronological primary forecast: Primary holdout and farther-tail loss beat all declared same-information controls.
criteria.Generative Yield: Linked state-transition loss beats zero-change and same-state controls.
criteria.Mechanism and rivals: All required rivals and monotone shrinkage are evaluated on the identical episode matrix.
criteria.Economic consequence: Paper policy includes costs and no capital authority.
criteria.Parsimony and stability: The sign and relative advantage survive both chronological evaluation partitions.

secondary_observable_contract.observable: next-year return-orthogonal ERP innovation and Treasury bond-minus-bill-spread change
secondary_observable_contract.measurement: per-coordinate RMSE on the frozen chronological holdout and farther-tail rows
secondary_observable_contract.expected_range: each coordinate strictly below zero-change, same-state interaction, and discrete-transition controls on each partition
secondary_observable_contract.falsifier: any linked-coordinate control equals or beats the candidate on either partition

evidence_contract.docstring: Frozen annual US market-state rows compiled from the public NYU historical implied-ERP table; current-revision diagnostic authority only.
